svg.title: DocuMind request flows
svg.desc: Two parallel flows: PDF upload on the left, text query on the right, each showing the step-by-step path from Telegram user through bot, API, AI engine, and data stores.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What PDF formats does the bot accept?')
sendPrompt('How does the bot receive text messages?')
sendPrompt('How does the bot forward a file upload?')
sendPrompt('What does the bot send in the /ask request?')
sendPrompt('How does the API resolve or create a session?')
sendPrompt('How does the API fetch the active session?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI service parse and ingest a PDF?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI service retrieve and answer?')
sendPrompt('What does the bot reply with after an upload?')
sendPrompt('What citations does the bot return?')
